title: Public Daily Blog Publishing, Border Hop Matching & Home Featured Puzzles
body:
- Daily Countrydle blog recaps are now published immediately after each puzzle day concludes without waiting for prior editorial review.
- Simplified Map Border Hop input so Polish counties no longer require typing 'powiat', Polish diacritics, or a voivodeship qualifier when the neighbor is unambiguous.
- Removed the New route button from Map Border Hop and expanded Featured puzzles and Also popular links on the Home page.
